decisions.reason: As a recently launched core equipment product with its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and sunk development effort, so management would likely continue unless clear failure had already emerged.

Because this newly introduced resin injection unit sits close to the firm's machinery business and was publicly presented as a standalone offering, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The automatic airless spray gun fits the established coating equipment domain and has already been put on the market visibly, so management would tend to give it more time rather than reverse course quickly.
As a new but directly related product in the firm's application equipment range, it is likely to be retained because recent investment and public launch create pressure to persist.
This air-assisted airless spray gun appears central to the firm's technical product family, and with no explicit poor results reported, management would likely keep supporting it.

Although the data logger is somewhat more peripheral than the core spray and injection units, it still complements the equipment portfolio and recent visible commitment makes an early withdrawal less likely than continued backing.
